title: SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor GetPdf Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute code on affected installations of SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the GetPdf function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
